page_title: LEC 2-1 MON | Lecce v Monza 15/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Pedro Pereira (Monza) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
90+4' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) sends a cross into the box, but Wladimiro Falcone comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+3' Monza take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+1' Pedro Pereira (Monza) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
90+1' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Omari Forson (Monza) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
89' The substitution has been made. Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) has replaced Santiago Pierotti.

87' Daniel Maldini (Monza) beautifully controls a cross from the wing inside the box, but he fails to test the keeper and sends his shot miles past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
86' The resulting set piece from Lecce is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

86' Ante Rebic (Lecce) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The linesman makes the right call and Lecce will have a corner.
83' Daniel Maldini (Monza) was probably a bit loose with his words to Maurizio Mariani, who decides to show him a yellow.
83' The foul by Mirko Maric (Monza) was seen by Maurizio Mariani who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Lecce.
81' Half-chance! Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) plays a pass into the box, but Wladimiro Falcone reacts well to snuff out the attack.
79' Alessandro Nesta has decided to substitute Alessandro Bianco and he is replaced by Mirko Maric (Monza).
79' It is time for a substitution. Pedro Pereira (Monza) is on for Samuele Birindelli.
78' The Lecce players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Maurizio Mariani. NO PENALTY!
76' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the penalty decision using the VAR system.
75' Omari Forson (Monza) is penalised for holding. Maurizio Mariani signals a set piece. PENALTY to Lecce! Great chance to score.
73' One of the players from Monza times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
71' Dany Mota (Monza) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) is coming onto the pitch as Hamza Rafia cannot continue after picking up an injury.
68' Marco Giampaolo decides to make a substitution. Nikola Krstovic will be replaced by Ante Rebic (Lecce).
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Armando Izzo trots off the pitch and is replaced by Stefano Sensi (Monza).
67' The referee allows time for a substitution. Gianluca Caprari will be replaced by Omari Forson (Monza).
66' Daniel Maldini (Monza) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
65' Handball! A player from Lecce handled the ball. Monza are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
65' NO PENALTY! Referee Maurizio Mariani has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Monza players are incensed.
64' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Monza as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
63' A penalty is given to Monza!
62' Monza have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
61' Monza force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
60' Now Monza have a corner.
60' Dany Mota (Monza) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Monza win a corner.
58' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Alessandro Bianco (Monza) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
57' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) pounces on a bouncing ball on the edge of the box, but sends his volley well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
55' Medon Berisha will be replaced by Ylber Ramadani (Lecce).
53' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Wladimiro Falcone intercepts the ball.
51' Pablo Mari (Monza) brings his opponent down. Maurizio Mariani has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Lecce will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
50' A pass from Dany Mota (Monza) is intercepted by Wladimiro Falcone and the move breaks down.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Medon Berisha (Lecce) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the left post only for Stefano Turati to dive and make a save.
45+2' Armando Izzo (Monza) trips an opposition player and Maurizio Mariani signals a foul. Lecce have been awarded a free kick.
45+1' 2 additional min. will be played.

44' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) scores with a brilliant shot into the left side of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Santiago Pierotti. The score is now 2:1.
43' Alessandro Bianco (Monza) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
41' Medon Berisha (Lecce) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
40' What was Armando Izzo (Monza) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
39' Andrea Carboni comes onto the pitch after Luca Caldirola (Monza) signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
37' 1 - 1 Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) has scored an own goal! No one would like to be in his shoes right now.
35' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle after Hamza Rafia (Lecce) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Monza have a free kick.
32' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Monza.

31' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the bottom right corner, but Wladimiro Falcone is prepared and dives to thwart him. It will be a corner kick for Monza.
30' Marco Giampaolo (Lecce) gets a yellow card, off the field.
28' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) has tested the patience of referee Maurizio Mariani and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
26' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
25' A spell of possession for Monza in an attempt to control the game.
23' Close! Daniel Maldini (Monza) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.

21' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Nikola Krstovic (Lecce), whose header flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
20' Maurizio Mariani shows a yellow card to Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) for his blatant foul.
19' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
17' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Monza comes to nothing.
14' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot.
14' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is going to take the penalty!
13' Alessandro Bianco (Monza) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Lecce are awarded a penalty!
10' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul. Monza win a free kick.
8' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
7' Monza failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
6' Monza spell of possession comes to an end after a mistake. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Monza.
3' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Medon Berisha laid the ball off to Tete Morente (Lecce), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
1' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) tackles a bit over-zealously and Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul. Lecce earn a free kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Lecce will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Maurizio Mariani.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
